note: A SMALLER proposal head at preserved proposal quality. The promoted head is kept tensor-for-tensor except for two changes that together remove 76,035,064 bytes (17.8%) from the weight set re-read on every draft step: the BF16 precision islands are dropped in full, and mlp.gate_proj/up_proj are re-quantised to affine 2-bit group-64. Head bytes are a candidate-exclusive cost -- the serial control runs zero head steps -- so none of the saving is refunded to the denominator of the paired ratio. Proposal quality is held, not traded: the 2-bit pair is trained with a straight-through estimator through the exact MLX affine packer against the promoted head's own distribution over the compact draft vocabulary, which lifts agreement from 0.9022 (plain re-quantisation) to 0.9658 and the proposal hit rate from 0.7257 to 0.7399 against the incumbent's 0.7425, i.e. a measured -0.0027 hit delta for -17.8% of head traffic. Measured on 3,744 real target hidden states from eight greedy decodes, two of them withheld from training; the incumbent reproduces 0.7425 on that set against the 0.7495 accepted-draft rate of its own gates ledger. Every fusion guard the shipped decoder keys on is preserved: q/k/v stay jointly affine-4 so the fused QKV pack and the island-completeness fast path are unaffected, gate and up move together so the fused gate/up product survives, down_proj stays affine-4, fc stays affine-4, and the affine-2 compact draft readout is byte-identical at [98336,320]/[98336,80] so the shortlist and its exact affine-4 rerank are the incumbent's unchanged. Precision islands are removed as a complete set, which is the only safe option: the loader enters its island block on any precision_islands key and refuses a partial set, while a head carrying none simply keeps the packed K/V path. The islands were worth 0.0029 of hit for 31,470,584 bytes, so removing them is close to neutral on quality and strictly negative on traffic. This arm makes no proposal-accuracy claim: the organizer's full-precision head, which has no quantisation error anywhere, proposes better by only 0.0024 while carrying 421,657,747 more bytes on every draft step, so accuracy is not the payable axis here and is not bought. The head only proposes; the pinned target decides every emitted token and the trusted parent re-checks the whole stream against the hidden serial trajectory after the clock stops, so the emitted stream is unchanged and only the accept rate and the per-step head cost can move. Manifest-only change: the Swift tree is byte-identical to the parent commit.
